title: Ulyana and the Rivergate
author: Beatrix Zhou
blurb: Coral Sterling, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
